name: Contagion

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A touch of disease: Con save or 11d8 Necrotic and Poisoned, with Disadvantage on saves of an ability you pick.
text: The Poisoned target repeats the Con save at the end of each of its turns until it has three successes (the spell ends) or three failures (it lasts the full 7 days). While it lasts, anything that would end the Poisoned condition needs the target to win a Con save first.
